_readme: This file tells every installed copy of Hostyllo Offline where the control
plane is. It is fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com on the master branch,
at most once a day per machine, by services/discovery.js. Editing it and
merging to master re-points the whole estate without cutting a release.
It must stay on MASTER at this path. The URL is pinned in services/discovery.js
(DISCOVERY_URL) and tests/discovery.test.js checks it against package.json's
publish config, so a repository rename cannot break discovery quietly.
apiBase must be https and must include the /v1 prefix — that is the
machine-facing surface. /admin is for people and must never appear here.
Anything that is not valid https is REFUSED and installs keep the address
they already had; a mistake here cannot switch 50 hostels off by accident.
SETTING apiBase TO null IS THE KILL SWITCH. It clears every install's cache
and returns them to offline-only operation, which is a fully supported state:
the local licence file decides everything and no network call is made. Use it
if the control plane has to come down.
BEFORE deleting or re-provisioning a Railway service, change this file FIRST
and give it a day. Generated *.up.railway.app subdomains are recycled, and an
install still pointing at a recycled name would send its licence key and
machine id to whoever claimed it. Nothing can be granted that way — entitlements
are signed by a key that is not on that host — but it would be received.
When license.hostyllo.com exists, point apiBase at it here first. Baking it
into DEFAULT_API_BASE is a later, separate step: a baked value outranks this
file, so do that only once the domain is proven.
